Maintenance Considerations
Maintenance and control of a completed transportation facility which has been designed to the latest technological and environmental considerations can be as important to preserving desirable ecosystems as the efforts which have been incorporated into the project development. The considerations which quided designers in laying out the route to achieve minimal adverse impacts can be negated through carelessness and inefficiency of maintenance.
The principle most cited as a disregard for the natural environment is the over use of road salts for de-icing pavements. While the impact of these chemicals on life systems is not quantitatively conclusive, the undesirable qualitative effects are generally recognized by all. However, the use of road salts will continue in sufficient quantity to insure safe, usable highways.
In view of the uncertainity of the effect of chlorides upon wildlife, the Division of Highways ascribes to applying these chemicals only under circumstances deemed necessary. Rock salt mixed with liquid calcium chloride is being used on I-94 between Milwaukee and Madison. This activates the salt more quickly and reduces the amount dispersed off the pavement.
